expected_information_gain: Remove arbitrary-real epsilon precision selection from the finite-data budget-to-dyadic-list path, without claiming source-angle enclosure generation or QR closure.
definition_kind: Literal computable Nat/Rat/Int allocator and Option composition; no exact-real evaluation or classical choice determines epsilon-dependent output.

algorithm.ceilingThreshold: Nat.ceil ((coefficientNat k n : Rat)/epsilon), using the computable rational FloorSemiring implementation, which evaluates rational numerator/denominator integer ceiling; its actual computational implementation must be exposed and executed, not assumed as a real evaluator.
algorithm.allocate: If 0<epsilon:Rat then some(bits k n epsilon), else none.
algorithm.supplyBudget: For exact finite PrimitiveCircuit and rational interval list, bind allocate to b, then frozen SafeEnclosure.supplyCircuit b exact intervals to returned, and return some(b,returned); failure returns none.

sealed_interfaces.coefficientNat_cast: forall k n : Nat, (coefficientNat k n : Real)=DyadicSupplier.errorCoefficient k n
sealed_interfaces.ceilingThreshold_bound: forall k n : Nat, epsilon:Rat, (coefficientNat k n : Rat)/epsilon <= (ceilingThreshold k n epsilon : Rat)
sealed_interfaces.bits_pow_bound: forall k n : Nat, epsilon:Rat, ceilingThreshold k n epsilon <= 2^(bits k n epsilon)
sealed_interfaces.bits_error_rat: forall k n : Nat, epsilon:Rat, 0<epsilon -> (coefficientNat k n : Rat)/(2:Rat)^(bits k n epsilon) <= epsilon
sealed_interfaces.bits_error_real: forall k n : Nat, epsilon:Rat, 0<epsilon -> DyadicSupplier.errorCoefficient k n/(2:Real)^(bits k n epsilon) <= (epsilon:Real)
sealed_interfaces.allocate_positive: forall k n epsilon, 0<epsilon -> allocate k n epsilon=some(bits k n epsilon)
sealed_interfaces.allocate_nonpositive: forall k n epsilon, epsilon<=0 -> allocate k n epsilon=none
sealed_interfaces.bits_size_bound: forall k n epsilon, bits k n epsilon <= Nat.size(max 1 (ceilingThreshold k n epsilon))
sealed_interfaces.allocated_numerator_bits: forall k n epsilon lo hi, Nat.size((SafeEnclosure.nearestNumerator (bits k n epsilon) lo hi).natAbs) <= Nat.size(lo.num.natAbs+hi.num.natAbs+1)+Nat.size(max 1 (ceilingThreshold k n epsilon))
sealed_interfaces.supplyBudget_positive: For 0<epsilon and supplyCircuit (bits k n epsilon) exact intervals=some returned, supplyBudget k n epsilon exact intervals=some(bits k n epsilon,returned)
sealed_interfaces.supplyBudget_nonpositive: For epsilon<=0, supplyBudget k n epsilon exact intervals=none
sealed_interfaces.hermite_internal_supplier: For k n:Nat,L:Real,hL:0<L,epsilon:Rat,he:0<epsilon and rational intervals, if intervals.length equals actual GlobalAssembly.compile RY count, ValidIntervals (bits k n epsilon) intervals and Sound actual-list intervals, then exists returned with supplyBudget k n epsilon actual-list intervals=some(bits k n epsilon,returned), identical returned.resource and eraseRyAngle chronology, and full Euclidean column error to frozen DyadicSupplier.target k n L <= (epsilon:Real). Actual successful return is obtained internally via frozen supplyCircuit_complete, not an input assumption.
